review_comments.body: Anyway we can clean this up to not require a duplicate return? Not following why the null check on content can't be applied to a singular return line? You premake the `summary`, you could do the same with `content` so we have 1 return

comments.body:
`OutputReasoning::toArray()` now builds `content` the same way as `summary` and returns a single payload. The null check is on that return: a null `content` is spread in as nothing, so the key stays off the array and existing items still round-trip. The reasoning-content tests pass (3), and Pint and PHPStan are clean on the file.


This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
